autem Moysen et locutus est ei Dominus d: the Lord Moses, and spoke to him from the tabernacle of the testimony,
et dices ad eos: homo: and thou shalt say to them: The man
Domino de pecoribus: to the Lord of the cattle,
fuerit eius oblatio ac de armento: his offering, and of the herd,
offeret ad ostium tabernaculi testimonii: he shall offer at the door of the tabernacle of the testimony,
ad placandum sibi Dominum: to make the Lord favourable to him
super hostie caput: upon the head of the victim,
et offerent filii Aaron sacerdotis: and the sons of Aaron the priest shall offer
strue lignorum ante composita: having before laid in order a pile of wood
et membra que cesa sunt desuper ordinant: and laying in order thereupon the parts that are cut out,
et cuncta que adherent iecori: and all things that cleave to the liver,
adolebitque ea sacerdos super altare: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar
et suavem odorem Domino: and a sweet savour to the Lord.
quod si de pecoribus oblatio est,: And if the offering be of the flocks,
immolabitque ad latus: And he shall immolate it at the side
AD LATUS ALTARIS QUOD RESPICIT AD AQUILO: AT THE SIDE OF THE ALTAR THAT LOOKETH TO THE NORTH
et omnia que adherent iecori: and all that cleave to the liver,
et imponent ligna: and shall lay them upon the wood,
quibus subiciendus est: under which is to be put
holocausti oblatio fuerit Domino de turt: the oblation of a holocaust to the Lord be, of turtles
et retorto ad collum capite: and twisting back the head to the neck,
ac rupto vulneris loco: and breaking the place of the wound,
vero gutturis et plumas: of the throat and the feathers
in loco in quo cineres effundi solent: in the place where the ashes are wont to be poured out
eius et non secabit nec ferro dividet ea: thereof, and shall not cut, nor divide it with a knife,
et adolebit super altare lignis: and shall burn it upon the altar, on the wood,
supposito holocaustum est: being put under: it is a holocaust
